mapper.select: SELECT DATE(created_at) FROM tbl_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(), 0) FROM tbl_transaction t WHERE
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.tr_date, '%Y-%m') AS `year_month`, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS amount FROM tbl_transaction t WHERE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.tr_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY `year_month`

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.tr_date, '%Y-%m') AS `year_month`, COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id) AS parent_category_id, COALESCE(p.category_name, c.category_name, '미분류') AS parent_category_name, t.category_id, COALESCE(c.category_name, '미분류') AS category_name, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS amount FROM tbl_transaction t LEFT JOIN tbl_category c ON c.id = t.category_id LEFT JOIN tbl_category p ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.tr_date, '%Y-%m'), COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id), COALESCE(p.category_name, c.category_name, '미분류'), t.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY `year_month`, amount DESC, t.category_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_fixed_expense_candidate WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_excluded = 0 AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN account_type = 'SECURITIES' THEN COALESCE( (SELECT SUM(ih.market_value) FROM tbl_investment_holding ih WHERE ih.account_id = tbl_connected_account.id), balance ) ELSE balance END ), 0) FROM tbl_connected_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_asset_snapshot ( user_id, `year_month`, net_worth, total_asset, total_debt, category_summary_json, ai_comment, compare_comment ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{yearMonth}, #{netWorth}, #{totalAsset}, #{totalDebt}, CAST(#{categorySummaryJson} AS JSON), NULL, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE net_worth = CASE WHEN ai_analysis_status IN ('NOT_REQUESTED', 'FAILED') THEN VALUES(net_worth) ELSE net_worth END, total_asset = CASE WHEN ai_analysis_status IN ('NOT_REQUESTED', 'FAILED') THEN VALUES(total_asset) ELSE total_asset END, total_debt = CASE WHEN ai_analysis_status IN ('NOT_REQUESTED', 'FAILED') THEN VALUES(total_debt) ELSE total_debt END, category_summary_json = CASE WHEN ai_analysis_status IN ('NOT_REQUESTED', 'FAILED') THEN VALUES(category_summary_json) ELSE category_summary_json END
mapper.select: SELECT id, ai_comment, compare_comment, ai_analysis_status FROM tbl_asset_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND `year_month` = #{yearMonth}
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_asset_snapshot SET ai_analysis_status = 'IN_PROGRESS', ai_analysis_provider = #{provider}, ai_analysis_model = #{model}, ai_analysis_prompt_version = #{promptVersion}, ai_analysis_input_hash = #{inputHash}, ai_analysis_attempt_count = ai_analysis_attempt_count + 1, ai_analysis_requested_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ai_analysis_completed_at = NULL, ai_analysis_failed_at = NULL, ai_analysis_failure_code = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND `year_month` = #{yearMonth} AND ai_analysis_status IN ('NOT_REQUESTED', 'FAILED')

UPDATE tbl_asset_snapshot SET ai_comment = CAST(#{feedbacksJson} AS JSON), compare_comment = #{savingsAnalogy}, ai_analysis_status = 'COMPLETED', ai_analysis_completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ai_analysis_failed_at = NULL, ai_analysis_failure_code = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND `year_month` = #{yearMonth} AND ai_analysis_status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
